MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The solder-seal connectors and heat shrink tubing fit my earlier electrical terminal purchase because they help me join wires and protect those connections.",
    "The small epoxy pack feels like a useful next choice after tape and vinyl cement because it offers a rigid bond for occasional repairs."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The feeler gauge, caliper and specific tap kit need a precise repair task to be useful, and I have no current task calling for them.",
    "The cutting wheels assume a metal-cutting project and suitable equipment, while the water-testing meters serve a need I have not shown.",
    "The large bottle of very thin super glue feels too specialized and excessive for my occasional repairs, even though I have bought adhesives before."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My repair purchases seem to have been taken as interest in workshop tools broadly, even when their purpose does not connect to my needs.",
    "My use of adhesives seems to have been stretched into interest in specialized formulas and large refill quantities."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "What matters is how an item helps with repairs like those I have already made, such as protecting electrical connections or bonding damaged parts.",
    "Related connectors can be alternatives: I would choose the solder-seal kit this time without also buying the similar crimp connector kit.",
    "My purchases span years, so an older repair supply purchase does not mean I am still working on that project or need specialized equipment now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations understood my interest in practical repair supplies but stretched that interest into specialized tools and projects I do not currently need."
}
